source.manualTitle: Whirlpool & Maytag 9.2 Cu. Ft. Steam Dryer Service Manual

steps.title: Disconnect power
steps.body: Unplug the dryer or disconnect power before servicing. Replace all parts and panels before operating.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Electrical Shock Hazard. Disconnect power before accessing.

steps.title: Continue procedure
steps.body: Service Diagnostics entered. Use Key Activation, fault scroll, or Service Test as needed, then continue below.
steps.sourceExcerpt: After diagnostic entry, proceed with OEM component test steps.

steps.title: Key Activation & Encoder Test
steps.body: Service Diagnostics → press 1st button (Key Activation & Encoder Test). Verify all indicators, buttons, and beeps.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Service Diagnostics → press 1st button (Key Activation & Encoder Test). Verify all indicators, buttons, and beeps.

images.caption: Removing top panel and console/HMI (W11737351 p.8)

steps.title: Key/encoder test result
steps.body: All indicators light, buttons respond, and beep heard?
steps.sourceExcerpt: All indicators light, buttons respond, and beep heard?

steps.title: ACU and UI connectors seated
steps.body: All connectors fully seated; UI assembly in console?
steps.sourceExcerpt: All connectors fully seated; UI assembly in console?

images.caption: Removing top panel and console/HMI (W11737351 p.8)

steps.title: Replace UI assembly
steps.oemOutcome: Replace user interface and housing assembly. If supply OK but UI dead, replace ACU.

steps.title: UI verified
steps.oemOutcome: Buttons and indicators respond in Key Activation & Encoder Test.
